The repair process is carried out by a Pakistani repair shop using various mechanical equipment such as a chain block and crane to lift the large engine from the vehicle, and a socket wrench to tighten the bolts to specifications. The engine block is then cleaned with a cleaning fluid to remove oil deposits, carbon deposits, and metal particles before being reassembled.
